semiconductor_relevance: High — KM Corp. specializes in cleanroom consumables essential for semiconductor manufacturing, including wipers and dust-free papers.
summary: KM Corp. focuses on providing localized cleanroom consumables for the semiconductor industry, including cleaning chemicals, wipes, and static control supplies. The company has established a strong presence by supplying products to major semiconductor factories and continuously developing new clean technologies.

regional_presence.South Korea: KM Corp. supplies cleanroom products to domestic semiconductor industries and has established relationships with major companies like IBM and NEC.
